headline: Viviana Power Tech: Regulation 29(2) SAST disclosure from Priyanka Choksi
sum: Mrs. Priyanka Choksi filed a mandatory Regulation 29(2) disclosure under SEBI SAST Regulations, notifying the NSE of a substantial acquisition of shares in Viviana Power Tech Limited. The filing formalizes a change in shareholding and triggers regulatory transparency requirements.
detail: Mrs. Priyanka Choksi submitted a disclosure to Viviana Power Tech Limited on or before 30 June 2026, in compliance with Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The company then informed the NSE. This is a routine but mandatory disclosure whenever a person crosses shareholding thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, etc.). The precise number of shares acquired, the acquisition date, and the price per share are not disclosed in the NSE filing summary itself—those details would appear in the full Regulation 29(2) Form filed with the company.
